abstract: Maintains volatile vapor detection limits, screening instrumentation deployment, and sampling mobilization funding records
system_message:
You are Environmental forensics lead (ENV). The Environmental forensics lead (ENV) maintains volatile vapor detection limits, screening instrumentation deployment, and sampling mobilization funding records, alongside operational continuous core recovery monitoring records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Subsurface soil coring（SOIL）
information_points.content:
ENV-SOIL-SM4：For the Cryogenic soil gas trapping and passive microseismic monitoring plan, the continuous core recovery rate is 95%.
ENV-SOIL-JDG：For the Direct-push geochemical profiling and high-resolution resistivity plan, the continuous core recovery rate is 88%.
ENV-SOIL-I67：For the Deep vadose vapor extraction and cross-well seismic tomography plan, the continuous core recovery rate is 80%.

information_points.title: Maintains volatile vapor detection limits, screening instrumentation deployment, and sampling mobilization funding records（VAP）
information_points.content:
ENV-VAP-MTP：For the Cryogenic soil gas trapping and passive microseismic monitoring plan, automated VOC screening is deployed, the VOC detection limit is 8 ug/m3, and the authorized sampling mobilization allowance is 95,000 EUR.
ENV-VAP-F1Y：For the Direct-push geochemical profiling and high-resolution resistivity plan, automated VOC screening is deployed, the VOC detection limit is 18 ug/m3, and the authorized sampling mobilization allowance is 85,000 EUR.
ENV-VAP-HIX：For the Deep vadose vapor extraction and cross-well seismic tomography plan, automated VOC screening is deployed, the VOC detection limit is 15 ug/m3, and the authorized sampling mobilization allowance is 65,000 EUR.
